item: kv_store cache: a per-key write version and a fill inside the gate close the reader-over-writer and writer-over-writer races
summary: F1: readers note a per-key version before reading and fill only if it has not moved, saves and deletes fill inside the gate in commit order; F3: a strict-mode violation names the calling code and thread; the freshness test pins the sqlcipher3 ceiling value in both pyproject and the registry
